name: m1_xxhash
command: CSUM=xxhash corpus/vm/make_image.sh m1_xxhash

name: m1_sha256_bgt
command: CSUM=sha256 MKFS_ARGS="-O block-group-tree" corpus/vm/make_image.sh m1_sha256_bgt

name: m1_blake2b
command: CSUM=blake2 corpus/vm/make_image.sh m1_blake2b

name: m1_lzo
command: CSUM=xxhash MOUNT_OPTS=compress-force=lzo,commit=5 corpus/vm/make_image.sh m1_lzo

name: m1_zlib
command: CSUM=xxhash MOUNT_OPTS=compress-force=zlib,commit=5 corpus/vm/make_image.sh m1_zlib

name: m1_unknown_incompat
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_xxhash.img images/scenarios/m1_unknown_incompat.img set-incompat-bit 40

name: m1_mirror_damage
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_xxhash.img images/scenarios/m1_mirror_damage.img zero-primary-sb

name: m1_foreign_mirror
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_xxhash.img images/scenarios/m1_foreign_mirror.img transplant-sb images/scenarios/m1_sha256_bgt.img 1 1000

name: m1_badnode
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_xxhash.img images/scenarios/m1_badnode.img flip-byte 107118591

name: m1_badnode_both
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_xxhash.img images/scenarios/m1_badnode_both.img flip-byte 107118591 174227455

name: m2_logtree
command: CSUM=xxhash SCENARIO=logtree MOUNT_OPTS=commit=300 DONE_MARKER="=== LOGTREE-POWEROFF" corpus/vm/make_image.sh m2_logtree

name: s01_discard_none_r1
command: NAME=s01_discard_none_r1 corpus/vm/scenarios/discard_none.sh
note: the run-1 image of its discard mode, as kept for EXP-000 and EXP-002

name: s01_discard_async_r1
command: NAME=s01_discard_async_r1 corpus/vm/scenarios/discard_async.sh
note: the run-1 image of its discard mode, as kept for EXP-000 and EXP-002

name: s01_discard_sync_r1
command: NAME=s01_discard_sync_r1 corpus/vm/scenarios/discard_sync.sh
note: the run-1 image of its discard mode, as kept for EXP-000 and EXP-002

name: m3_wide
command: CSUM=xxhash SCENARIO=wide corpus/vm/make_image.sh m3_wide
note: trees with internal nodes: 48 subvolumes, 1500 files, deletions between commits, no balance

name: m4_planted_slack
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m3_wide.img images/scenarios/m4_planted_slack.img plant-slack
note: m3_wide with a message hidden in the slack of the fs tree's root node and first leaf, checksums recomputed (EXP-005; Toolan & Humphries 2026)

name: m4_deep
command: CSUM=xxhash SCENARIO=deep MOUNT_OPTS=commit=300 DONE_MARKER="=== DEEP-POWEROFF" corpus/vm/make_image.sh m4_deep
note: history deeper than the backup roots, no balance: 24 victims each committed in one generation, 8 flash files that exist only in dropped log trees, one file unlinked while open (ORPHAN_ITEM), one small file renamed per round, power-off after the last commit; the log holds the ground-truth hashes and every create, rename and delete with its inode and generation (EXP-009)

name: m4_deep_lost_parent
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m4_deep.img images/scenarios/m4_deep_lost_parent.img lose-root-node
note: m4_deep with every copy of its oldest surviving root-tree node corrupted: root-tree leaves whose parent is lost (EXP-004 §6.8)

name: m5_delsubvol
command: CSUM=xxhash SCENARIO=delsubvol MOUNT_OPTS=commit=5 corpus/vm/make_image.sh m5_delsubvol
note: a subvolume with a two-level tree, filled, committed, deleted and cleaned; three more commits; SHA-256 of two of its files in the log

name: m5_delsubvol_lost_items
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m5_delsubvol.img images/scenarios/m5_delsubvol_lost_items.img lose-root-items 257
note: m5_delsubvol with every root-tree leaf that names the deleted subvolume (tree 257) broken in every copy: no ROOT_ITEM of any generation leads to it

name: m5_reuse
command: CSUM=xxhash SCENARIO=reuse MOUNT_OPTS=commit=5,nodiscard corpus/vm/make_image.sh m5_reuse
note: a logical chunk range reused on other physical bytes: six data chunks, the three holding only deleted files removed by balance -dusage=0, the next chunk at the topmost one's logical address on the hole of two lower ones; the log holds every file's SHA-256 and the chunk, block-group and device-extent items at three points (EXP-010)

name: m5_reuse_same
command: CSUM=xxhash SCENARIO=reuse_same MOUNT_OPTS=commit=5,nodiscard corpus/vm/make_image.sh m5_reuse_same
note: the control of m5_reuse: the next chunk reuses the removed topmost chunk's logical range on its own physical bytes (EXP-010)

name: m6_datacsum
command: CSUM=crc32c MKFS_ARGS="-d dup" SCENARIO=datacsum MOUNT_OPTS=commit=5 corpus/vm/make_image.sh m6_datacsum
note: data checksums (plan.md M6a): data and metadata DUP, crc32c; a regular, an inline, a prealloc and a zstd-compressed file, two files for flip-data, and one written after remount,nodatasum; SHA-256 of each in the log

name: m6_datacsum_flipped
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m6_datacsum.img images/scenarios/m6_datacsum_flipped.img flip-data repairable.txt 1 damaged.txt all
note: m6_datacsum with the first byte of repairable.txt inverted in mirror 1 (the checksum repairs it from mirror 2) and of damaged.txt in both mirrors (a mismatch); checksums left stale

name: m6_reformat
command: NAME=m6_reformat NEW_LIFE=0 corpus/vm/scenarios/reformat.sh
note: a reformat (plan.md M6f): xxhash, nodesize 16 KiB, one life of the foreign scenario, then the pinned mkfs again with the same options over the whole image and no life after it; the log holds the old fsid and device uuid

name: m6_reformat_geometry
command: NAME=m6_reformat_geometry OLD_CSUM=crc32c OLD_MKFS_ARGS="-n 32768" NEW_MKFS_ARGS="--mixed -b 60M" corpus/vm/scenarios/reformat.sh
note: a reformat to another geometry (plan.md M6f): crc32c, nodesize 32 KiB, one life, then mkfs --mixed -b 60M with xxhash (nodesize 4 KiB) and a second life; the old mirror-1 superblock at 64 MiB survives, outside the new size

name: m6_fsid_u
command: NAME=m6_fsid_u TUNE=-u corpus/vm/scenarios/fsid_change.sh
note: an fsid change (plan.md M6f): one life, btrfstune -u (blocks the extent tree no longer lists keep the old fsid), a second life; the log holds both fsids and the device uuid

name: m6_fsid_m
command: NAME=m6_fsid_m TUNE=-m corpus/vm/scenarios/fsid_change.sh
note: an fsid change through metadata_uuid (plan.md M6f): one life, btrfstune -m (no tree block header changes), a second life

name: m6_hide_sb_reserved
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_sha256_bgt.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_sb_reserved.img plant-sb-reserved
note: a message in the superblock's reserved[199] (0x264) of every copy, checksums recomputed (plan.md M6d; Toolan & Humphries 2026)

name: m6_hide_sb_gated
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_blake2b.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_sb_gated.img plant-sb-reserved --field nr_global_roots
note: a message in the superblock's nr_global_roots of every copy, whose EXTENT_TREE_V2 flag is clear: spare room only by the feature flags (plan.md M6d; research.md §10.13)

name: m6_hide_sb_padding
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_xxhash.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_sb_padding.img plant-sb-padding
note: a message in the superblock's padding (0xDCB) of every copy, checksums recomputed (plan.md M6d)

name: m6_hide_chunk_array
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m6_datacsum.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_chunk_array.img plant-chunk-array-slack
note: a message at the end of the sys_chunk_array of every copy, behind the stale tail mkfs left, checksums recomputed (plan.md M6d)

name: m6_hide_backup_roots
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_blake2b.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_backup_roots.img plant-backup-roots
note: the oldest backup root slot copied over the slot of the superblock's generation in every copy, checksums recomputed: backup-root divergence (plan.md M6d)

name: m6_hide_pre_sb
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_sha256_bgt.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_pre_sb.img plant-pre-sb
note: a message at 0x8000, in the first 64 KiB before the primary superblock (plan.md M6d; Wani et al. 2020)

name: m6_hide_inode_reserved
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_blake2b.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_inode_reserved.img plant-inode-reserved
note: a message in the reserved bytes of the first regular file's INODE_ITEM, leaf checksum recomputed in every copy (plan.md M6d)

name: m6_hide_nsec
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_xxhash.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_nsec.img plant-nsec
note: 16 bytes in the four nanosecond fields of the first regular file's INODE_ITEM, each value 10^9 or more, leaf checksum recomputed (plan.md M6d; Göbel et al. 2024)

name: m6_hide_string_item
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m6_datacsum.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_string_item.img plant-string-item
note: a STRING_ITEM (253) appended to the fs tree's last leaf, leaf checksum recomputed in every copy (plan.md M6d; Toolan & Humphries 2026 §3.6)

name: m6_hide_file_slack
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m6_datacsum.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_file_slack.img plant-file-slack plain.txt
note: a message past the end of plain.txt in its last sector, both data copies, its EXTENT_CSUM entry and the csum-tree leaf rewritten (plan.md M6d; Göbel et al. 2024)

name: m6_hide_device_slack
command: uv run python corpus/mutate.py images/scenarios/m1_sha256_bgt.img images/scenarios/m6_hide_device_slack.img plant-device-slack
note: a message past the last device extent, where no historical chunk was (plan.md M6d; Wani et al. 2020)

name: m6_hidden_snapshot
command: CSUM=crc32c SCENARIO=hidden MOUNT_OPTS=commit=5 corpus/vm/make_image.sh m6_hidden_snapshot
note: a snapshot named U+FEFF moved into .lib32, beside a normally named one, after Schwietert & Hilgert 2025 (plan.md M6d); the log holds both subvolume ids
